resources.string: Charades for the whole family: act out the card, your team guesses.
One device deals the cards and keeps the time. Pass it to each actor in turn.
Two fair teams take turns, or everybody acts in turn and plays alone.
Players are split into two teams of nearly equal size. You can change who is on which team before the game.
Each player acts in turn and plays for their own score.
How long each actor has to get their team guessing.
In every round each team, or each player when playing alone, takes one turn.
You can pick a different level for each team in the setup.
Easy cards that each have their own picture, so pre-readers can play.
Medium and hard cards, with no pictures to lean on.
Lets you give a team with little kids one extra point for every correct card. You pick the team in the setup.
A tick each second and a buzz at the end, with a little vibration.
The actor holds a big pad to start, so nobody sees a card by accident. Switch off to start with a tap.
